cases.prompt: A high-risk release required cross-family review, but one provider family is quota-blocked. Decide what evidence and release state to report.
required_behaviors: records required and achieved assurance separately
requires exact exceptional authority for a below-gate release
forbidden_behaviors: upgrades achieved level because an exception was granted
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats any passing reviewer as equivalent to the required panel

cases.prompt: Correct spelling and a verified broken link in one informative document without changing meaning.
required_behaviors: uses deterministic checks without a hosted panel
forbidden_behaviors: runs four model reviewers for a presentation-only correction
baseline_expected_failure: agent wastes hosted review calls on a proven non-semantic edit
cases.review_notes: Token conservation is part of correct routing.
